newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold easier, expecting further falls.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold easier, expecting further falls.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange dropped to 1,072 kilos on Monday, from Friday's 1,214 kilos despite lower prices as traders were sidelined expecting further falls, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $338.00 an ounce and 1,590,500 lira per gram, compared to $339.80 and 1,600,900 lira on Friday, following sharply lower levels on European markets.
Most of the day's volume -- 812 kilos -- took place in the morning and 70.1 percent of the total trade was in lira.
